# National Endowment for the Humanities

> The NEH is a federal agency that funds and supports humanities research, education, and cultural preservation across America through grants, awards, and public programs.

The National Endowment for the Humanities (NEH) distributes federal funding to advance understanding of American history, culture, and humanities disciplines. The agency operates through multiple divisions and maintains partnerships with state humanities councils and educational institutions nationwide.
